justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses a newtype JobId, typed JobState enum, and typed QueueError variants; internal Job struct uses Option<Instant> rather than encoding state-specific data in the enum, leaving some modeling on the table.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinguishing variants and Display impl; uses an assert! in new() rather than returning a Result, which is a minor panic point without documentation.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives and a Display impl exist, but no doc comments appear on any public item and QueueError lacks a std::error::Error impl.
justifications.idiomaticity: get_state uses a verbose manual match instead of cloning/copying the enum, checkout clones the payload unnecessarily, and the retry-delay computation manually reimplements shifts rather than using saturating arithmetic idioms.
